title: Deep Hα survey of the Coma cluster: The Catalog
comment: This paper includes 22 pages and 13 figures, and was submitted to The Astronomical Journal in 2012. The authors acknowledge the important contributions of the Dr. David Carter, Principal Investigator of the ACS Coma Cluster Survey, who has since passed away
abstract: We present a deep wide-field narrow-band imaging survey of the local rich and dynamically relaxed Coma cluster of galaxies, carried out with the Wide Field Camera at the Isaac Newton Telescope. The survey covers a region of about 2.5 sq. deg. extending from the core of the cluster out to the infall region over the south-west quadrant of the Coma cluster. The $R$ (6380~Å) and $[$S$\scriptstyle\rm II$$]$ (6725~Å) filters of WFC/INT were used to derive the H$α$+[N{\sc ii}] fluxes and equivalent widths of cluster galaxies distributed over a wide range of environmental conditions. The depth of our imaging observations allows us to measure reliably those properties well down into the dwarf regime in the Coma cluster for the first time. We have detected 124 H$α$ emitting sources with spectroscopically-determined membership, 96 of which have not been detected previously. In this paper, we report on the data analysis process and the methodology we used to measure reliable H$α$ properties, and present the measurement catalogue.
